title: Prove optimal four-addition, one-halving Pauli pairing normalization (no κ)
body:
## Summary

A scoped mathematical proof and explicit circuit give the exact normalization tariff of a three-bank anticommuting-Pauli skew pairing: **four cross-bank additions and one bank halving**. No workspace is needed. Matching lower bounds hold even with any finite restored clean or dirty workspace, in the declared gate model.

```text
K = [[0,I,X],[-I,0,Z],[-X,-Z,0]],  X²=Z²=I, XZ=-ZX

c += Z*a; c -= X*b; c = X*Z*c/2
 a -= X*c; b -= Z*c
swap(a,b); a = -a
```

The final banks are K^-1 times the input. The Pauli relabeling, bank swap and negation are explicit and outside the two resource counts. Pauli-weighted additions are granted by this model; their physical delivery is not declared free.

The odd-skew commutative/noncommutative rank separation is classical, as in Garg, Gurvits, Oliveira and Wigderson, Example 1.3, arXiv:1511.03730. This contribution claims the specified Pauli normalization circuit and its exact resource optimum, not that rank phenomenon. The result was produced by Nick Petalas. Ali Romman's #5615 supplies the scalar helper-pairing context and retains its P104 predecessors.

Only `research/pauli-skew-pairing-normalizer/` is added. Canonical base is `19fdb086ea96af9a9f87936a2b888e10af4ed810`, priority revision 8. The coverage-law card's changed scope is explicit. [Advance CLAIM](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-19227593).

## Evidence

- **Before:** the commuting scalar pattern has rank two. **After:** the Pauli pattern has the displayed dyadic inverse, normalized at the proved optimum. The rank distinction is credited as classical.
- Normal and optimized checks pass all 140 signed translation/character Pauli cases at widths 1..3 and all 3,000 input basis columns. A separate closed inverse and both dense inverse products agree with the literal circuit.
- All 81 scalar fixtures, the complete support-union domains through three additions with 3..6 banks, nine rejection controls and the extra unexpected-argument control pass. The universal lower bounds rest on the written support and integrality proofs, not finite extrapolation.
- Package metadata, final registered normal/optimized replay, committed bytes/source history/modes, syntax, indentation and function bounds pass locally. Local CPython 3.12.15 on macOS arm64 takes 2.59 and 2.98 seconds per scientific command, below the 120-second registered limits. These are check durations, not a speedup claim. No external Python linter is installed.
- Generated stdout receipts bind all five package files by SHA256. No receipt is handwritten. The verifier imports no predecessor program and writes no files.

Exact reproduction from the repository root:

```sh
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -I -W error -B research/pauli-skew-pairing-normalizer/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -I -W error -O -B research/pauli-skew-pairing-normalizer/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/pauli-skew-pairing-normalizer
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/pauli-skew-pairing-normalizer --check-source-history --check-modes
```

Any equivalent CPython 3.12 path may be substituted. Expected markers are `PASS_PAULI_SKEW_PAIRING_NORMALIZER`, `PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE` and `PASS_RESEARCH_COMMIT_BYTES`.

## Limitations and unrun obligations

This is an abstract operator-valued interface, with an exact tariff for the declared resources. It supplies no actual P104 prefix/suffix modules, causal cut, physical carrier, frame alignment, native delivery or complete paid/productive invoice. Unary relabeling costs and the physical implementation of operator additions remain payable. No actual helper split, new kappa, supplier admission or selected-frontier change is claimed.

Full selected replay, compiler/caller integration, rounded arithmetic, precision/tape costs, Lean, Docker, independent human review and formal proof-kernel acceptance were not run or claimed. The first scoped result ended the investigation.

## Open next questions

1. Can an actual causal helper cut realize this pairing while preserving every arbitrary dirty input? Publish its exact prefix, suffix and legal charts before claiming a channel.
2. Can the four Pauli additions, halving and unary relabelings fit a favorable complete signed moment? Price all delivery, ownership and target debits before expanding the construction.

- #5979 minimizes returned rows in a Pauli observation-history model. This minimizes elementary normalization gates for a specified three-bank matrix; it is a different model and quantity.
- #5606 prepares a concrete scalar split helper and prices its complete conditional invoice. This supplies no competing invoice or saving.
- #5553 gives concrete scalar successor hand-offs on a P104 word. This supplies no physical successor schedule or competing target count.

No additional computations were run to check these predecessors or parallel contributions.
